# `vl doctor`

Check this machine's setup and explain every problem found: identity, VEIL_HOME, the repository and its lock, the stat cache, the filesystem (case sensitivity, fsync, network mounts), the clock, the vault and leftover sandboxes. Exits 1 if anything is broken

```text
vl doctor [OPTIONS]
```
